g.text: SB1-A link, unfolded flat, seen from the contact face
GND at the BOTTOM at both connectors: both wired in reverse (GND on pad 20), pad n meets pad n
Gold ends = exposed contacts (4 mm), both on this face. ~51 mm overall; height drawn 3x.

g.text: It is the same 51 mm Type A cable on both sides, the same way up: GND on the bottom wire, contacts facing you at both ends. Both links are identical: SB1 J7 to MB-USB J2 / J3, all wired in reverse (11/8).
Heights are on Mainboard-USB (SB1 y + 8). The bracket must hold each SB1 top edge at MB y 8, to about +/-0.5 mm.
